Safe direction resolved from the call sites, not from the item phrasing: the item said 'error = presume operator OFFLINE, i.e. do NOT spend', but those two halves contradict each other, because in BOTH files every call site treats offline=True as the GO branch (afk_orchestrator run_afk line 64 runs the whole cadence, _right_size line 51 grants full budget, status line 136 reports it; capability_steal expand line 125 steal-searches, _right_size line 62 grants full budget).
